title: AL Development Fundamentals
description: Master the Application Language (AL) from scratch. Learn syntax, data types, variables, and the core building blocks of Business Central extension development. This comprehensive course takes you from zero to building your first AL objects.
shortDescription: Learn AL programming from fundamentals to your first BC extension.
learningOutcomes: Understand AL syntax and programming fundamentals
Set up a complete BC development environment with Docker
Create tables, pages, and codeunits in AL
Work with events, triggers, and procedures
Build and publish your first BC extension
prerequisites: Familiarity with ERP concepts is helpful but not required

modules.title: Introduction to AL
modules.description: Get started with AL programming and understand the Business Central development landscape.

modules.title: Development Environment
modules.description: Set up Visual Studio Code, Docker, and your first BC sandbox container.

modules.title: Working with Tables
modules.description: Learn to create and extend tables — the foundation of every BC extension.
